sources.title: Aion Labs models API: aion-labs/aion-rp-llama-3.1-8b
sources.evidence: Exact API identifier has date 2024-11-30, name AionLabs: Aion-RP 1.0 (8B), context_length 32768, text-to-text modality, reasoning false, tool_calls false, and reasoning_effort.supported false. Described as a Llama 3.1 8B variant for roleplaying and storytelling. Read through web browser tool; a separate Python HTTP request returned 403.

sources.title: Models — Aion Labs Docs
sources.evidence: Developer documentation independently displays the exact model ID, roleplaying purpose, 32K served context and explicit Released: 2024-11-30.

sources.title: Aion-RP-Llama-3.1-8B model card at 8ae617bc
sources.evidence: Developer-owned card names meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B as base model, declares apache-2.0 metadata, describes roleplaying and creative-writing training, claims full 131K context and documents a custom text conversation format. Immutable raw source successfully fetched.

sources.title: Aion-RP-Llama-3.1-8B configuration at 8ae617bc
sources.evidence: Exact fine-tune configuration specifies LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden size 4096, intermediate size 14336, 32 attention heads, eight KV heads, untied embeddings, vocabulary 128256 and max_position_embeddings 131072. Standard dense Llama components, not an expert-routing configuration.

sources.title: Aion-RP-Llama-3.1-8B weight index at 8ae617bc
sources.evidence: Public index lists seven weight shards and 291 tensors comprising embeddings, language-model head, normalization and dense attention/MLP projections. Total F32 tensor size 32,121,044,992 bytes corresponds to 8,030,261,248 parameters and matches the count derived from its config.

sources.title: Hugging Face repository metadata for the exact Aion fine-tune
sources.publisher: Hugging Face; model repository owned by Aion Labs
sources.evidence: Reports current revision 8ae617bc85c5d6698c3323863c42098d1998f7bb, 8,030,261,248 F32 safetensors parameters, creation 2024-11-09 and last modification 2024-11-30. Creation time is not treated as a confirmed public release date.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: The explicitly identified base model uses the Llama 3.1 Community License, whose redistribution provisions cover derivatives. This leaves an unresolved qualification to the fine-tune card declaring only Apache-2.0; no separate license document appears in the fine-tune repository.

name.note: Matches official display name after omitting the provider prefix.

developer.note: The publisher of this fine-tune is Aion Labs; Meta developed the stated base model.

family.note: Fine-tune card explicitly identifies the Llama 3.1 8B base, and its own config retains LlamaForCausalLM.

release_date.note: Explicit developer-reported release date supersedes baseline 2025-02-04. Repository creation is earlier (2024-11-09), so this is not a claim that no weights existed before November 30.

open_weights.note: Exact fine-tune publishes seven safetensors weight shards. This confirms availability, not a permissive-license conclusion.

license.note: Fine-tune card declares Apache-2.0, but the expressly identified base carries the Llama 3.1 Community License with derivative redistribution provisions. Retain null pending clarification rather than presenting Apache-2.0 as the complete governing license.

parameters_b.note: 8B is the nominal size. Exact published F32 tensor count is 8,030,261,248 (8.030261248 billion), independently consistent with its config dimensions and weight-index byte total. Verification uses the fine-tune artifacts, not just its name or base-model size.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate per-token active-parameter count is defined for this dense fine-tune. Do not copy the total parameter count into this field.

architecture.note: Exact fine-tune artifacts implement a dense decoder-only Llama causal transformer with grouped-query attention and dense MLP projections; no MoE routing or expert tensor groups are present.

context_window.note: Retain the exact API endpoint limit of 32768. Separately, downloadable weights declare and configure 131072 positions. The deployment limit is not the weight architecture limit.

modalities.note: Exact Aion endpoint explicitly reports text-to-text; the fine-tune card supplies a text conversation template.

reasoning.note: Exact endpoint reports reasoning false and reasoning-effort support false. This concerns dedicated reasoning support, not an assertion that the model cannot solve reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: Exact endpoint reports tool_calls false; no tool support is inherited merely because other Llama variants provide it.

description.value: Llama 3.1 8B fine-tune for roleplaying and creative writing.
description.note: Replace generic instruction-model, multilingual, reasoning and coding claims with the purpose documented for this exact fine-tune.

patch.description: Llama 3.1 8B fine-tune for roleplaying and creative writing.
patch.notes: 8B is nominal; published weights contain 8,030,261,248 parameters. Active parameters are not separately reported. API context is 32,768 tokens; the downloadable fine-tune config supports 131,072 positions. Developer reports release on 2024-11-30, while the repository was created on 2024-11-09. Fine-tune metadata declares Apache-2.0, but its Llama 3.1 base has a separate community license; the complete licensing position is unresolved.

summary: Confirmed exact fine-tune and API capabilities from primary sources. Correct release date to the developer-reported 2024-11-30, replace unsupported generic description, establish dense architecture and primary-source provenance for nominal 8B parameters. Preserve 32768 API context while documenting 131072 for downloadable weights. Leave active count null; licensing remains unresolved because the fine-tune Apache-2.0 declaration does not explain the upstream Llama terms.
